name: review-pack
title: Incident review record
for_each: select id,reference from incidents order by reference

sections.title: Chronology
sections.sql: select happened_at,note,evidence,actor from timeline where incident_id=$1 order by happened_at

sections.title: Corrective actions
sections.sql: select name,owner,due_on,state,completed_at,evidence from actions where incident_id=$1 order by due_on

name: action-brief
title: Corrective action brief
for_each: select id,reference from incidents where exists(select 1 from actions where incident_id=incidents.id) order by reference

sections.title: Corrective actions
sections.sql: select name,owner,due_on,state,completed_at,evidence from actions where incident_id=$1 order by due_on
